requirement_text: User shall be able to access the control panel based on their role as administrator, employer, or job seeker.
user_story: As a user, I want to open the control panel according to my role as administrator, employer or job seeker, so that I see the functions that suit my role.
technical_task: Provide a control panel whose access and content depend on whether the user is an administrator, an employer or a job seeker.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with the role administrator, employer or job seeker, when the user opens the control panel, then the panel for that role is shown.
Given a user without any of these roles, when the user tries to open the control panel, then access is denied.
rationale: The three roles are stated in the requirement. The second criterion is an assumption.

requirement_text: System shall customize the user's homepage based on previous interactions, including wish-list additions, page views, and previous searches.
user_story: As a shopper, I want my homepage customized from my wish-list additions, page views and previous searches, so that I see items that interest me.
technical_task: Personalize the user's homepage using their wish-list additions, page views and previous searches.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with wish-list additions, page views and previous searches, when the user opens the homepage, then the homepage is customized using them.
Given a user with no history, when the user opens the homepage, then the default homepage is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: shopper. The second criterion is an assumption.

requirement_text: System shall allow users to search for buses using destination, boarding place, and date of journey, displaying available buses according to user requirements.
user_story: As a traveler, I want to search for buses by destination, boarding place and date of journey and see the available buses, so that I can choose one that suits me.
technical_task: Implement a bus search by destination, boarding place and date of journey that lists the available buses matching the user's requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Given a destination, a boarding place and a date of journey, when the user searches, then the available buses matching them are displayed.
Given no bus available for the entered details, when the user searches, then no buses are displayed.

requirement_text: The website shall prevent its data from being corrupted when incorrect data is entered in.
requirement_text_raw: The website shall prevent its data from being corrupted when incorrect data is entered in.'
user_story: As a site owner, I want the website to stop incorrect input from corrupting its data, so that stored data stays reliable.
technical_task: Validate and reject incorrect input so that it cannot damage stored data.
acceptance_criteria: Given incorrect data is entered, when it is submitted, then it is rejected and the stored data is unchanged.
Given correct data is entered, when it is submitted, then it is stored.
rationale: Role assumed: site owner. What counts as incorrect data is not defined.

requirement_text: The system shall store camper records from previous years for reference.
user_story: As a camp director, I want camper records from previous years stored, so that I can refer to them.
technical_task: Retain camper records of past years and make them available for reference.
acceptance_criteria: Given camper records from a previous year, when a new year starts, then the records are still stored.
Given a stored previous-year record, when the camp director opens it, then it can be viewed.

requirement_text: System shall maintain updated descriptions of datasets throughout the project lifecycle.
user_story: As a data steward, I want dataset descriptions kept up to date through the project lifecycle, so that they stay accurate.
technical_task: Keep dataset descriptions current throughout the project lifecycle.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dataset whose content changes, when the change is made, then its description can be updated.
Given a dataset, when it is viewed at any stage of the project lifecycle, then its description is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: data steward. How updates are triggered is not stated.

requirement_text: Managers shall be able to delete tasks from the system.
user_story: As a manager, I want to delete tasks from the system, so that outdated tasks are removed.
technical_task: Allow managers to delete tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Given a task, when a manager deletes it, then it is removed from the system.
Given a user who is not a manager, when the user tries to delete a task, then it is not deleted.
rationale: Role stated: manager. The second criterion follows from "Managers shall".

requirement_text: System shall verify the mobile number and prompt for first name and last name.
user_story: As a new user, I want my mobile number verified and to be asked for my first and last name, so that my account details are complete.
technical_task: Verify the entered mobile number and prompt for first name and last name.
acceptance_criteria: Given a mobile number, when the user submits it, then the system verifies it.
Given a verified mobile number, when the user continues, then the system prompts for first name and last name.

requirement_text: Workers shall be able to view rewards.
user_story: As a worker, I want to view rewards, so that I know what I have earned.
technical_task: Display the rewards available to workers.
acceptance_criteria: Given a worker with rewards, when the worker opens the rewards page, then the rewards are shown.
Given a worker with no rewards, when the worker opens the rewards page, then it shows that there are none.

requirement_text: The operational requirement for direct mode is to: (I) provide short range fall-back communications between train drivers and trackside personnel in the event of failure of mobile telephony services normally available; provide short range communications for railway personnel operating in remote areas where no mobile telephony facilities are available.
requirement_text_raw: 15.1.1 The operational requirement for direct mode is to: (I) provide short range fall-back communications between train drivers and trackside personnel in the event of failure of mobile telephony services normally available; provide short range communications for railway personnel operating in remote areas where no mobile telephony facilities are available.
user_story: As a train driver, I want short range fall-back communications with trackside personnel when mobile telephony fails, and for railway personnel in remote areas without mobile telephony, so that communication is possible.
technical_task: Provide a direct mode for short range communications between train drivers and trackside personnel when mobile telephony is unavailable or has failed, including in remote areas without mobile telephony.
acceptance_criteria: Given mobile telephony services have failed, when a train driver calls trackside personnel, then short range direct mode communication is possible.
Given a remote area with no mobile telephony facilities, when railway personnel communicate, then short range direct mode communication is possible.
rationale: Role assumed: train driver. The two cases come from the requirement.

requirement_text: System shall allow the administrator to register members by manually inputting their information into the system.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to register members by entering their information manually, so that members can be added without self-registration.
technical_task: Provide a form for the administrator to register a member with manually entered information.
acceptance_criteria: Given the registration form, when the administrator enters a member's information and saves, then the member is registered.
Given the saved member, when the member list is opened, then the member is listed.

requirement_text: The system shall acknowledge user actions with confirmation to ensure application reliability for business purposes.
user_story: As a user, I want each of my actions acknowledged with a confirmation, so that I know the application received it.
technical_task: Show a confirmation after every user action.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user performs an action, when the action completes, then a confirmation is shown.
Given an action that fails, when it ends, then no success confirmation is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The business reliability aim is not measurable, so the criteria cover the confirmation.

requirement_text: Plug-in API will be well-documented for plug-in developers.
clarification_questions: What makes the Plug-in API "well-documented" in testable terms?
Which parts of the API must be documented?

requirement_text: System shall be able to place a marker for each historical site on the map, including the site name, a short description, and a link to the sites page.
user_story: As a visitor, I want a marker on the map for each historical site with its name, a short description and a link to its page, so that I can explore the sites.
technical_task: Place a map marker for every historical site that shows the site name, a short description and a link to the site's page.
acceptance_criteria: Given historical sites, when the map is displayed, then a marker is shown for each site.
Given a marker, when the visitor opens it, then the site name, a short description and a link to the site's page are shown.

requirement_text: System shall utilize cryptographic techniques for user authentication (future version).
user_story: As a user, I want cryptographic techniques used for authentication in a future version, so that my login is stronger.
technical_task: Plan the use of cryptographic techniques for user authentication in a future version.
acceptance_criteria: Given the future version, when a user authenticates, then cryptographic techniques are used.
Given the current version, when it is reviewed, then this requirement is not yet required to be in place.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The requirement is marked as a future version.

requirement_text: If the vehicle possesses a variable partition window between the front seat row and the rear seat row, the system shall apply the last mode principle on InCarCom front-to-rear if the partition window is not closed.
user_story: As a passenger, I want the last mode principle applied front-to-rear on InCarCom when the partition window is not closed, so that communication behaves consistently.
technical_task: For vehicles with a variable partition window between the front and rear seat rows, apply the last mode principle on InCarCom from front to rear while the partition window is not closed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a vehicle with a variable partition window and the window is not closed, when InCarCom front-to-rear is used, then the last mode principle is applied.
Given a vehicle without a variable partition window, when InCarCom is used, then this requirement does not apply.
rationale: Role assumed: passenger. The last mode principle is not defined in the sentence.

requirement_text: The system shall accept the product identification parameter and new price for the product as input.
user_story: As a shop manager, I want to enter a product identification parameter and a new price, so that I can change a product's price.
technical_task: Accept a product identification parameter and a new price as inputs for a price change.
acceptance_criteria: Given a product identification parameter and a new price, when they are submitted, then the system accepts both inputs.
Given a missing product identification parameter or price, when the input is submitted, then it is not accepted.

requirement_text: The SEP shall have a resolution of 20 msec. for 50 Hz tasks, 100 msec for 10 Hz tasks, and 1 second for 1 Hz tasks.
requirement_text_raw: The SEP shall (3.3.10.14) have a resolution of 20 msec. for 50 Hz tasks, 100 msec for 10 Hz tasks, and 1 second for 1 Hz tasks.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the SEP resolution to be 20 msec. for 50 Hz tasks, 100 msec for 10 Hz tasks and 1 second for 1 Hz tasks, so that timing is fine enough for each rate.
technical_task: Configure the SEP resolution per rate: 20 msec. for 50 Hz tasks, 100 msec for 10 Hz tasks and 1 second for 1 Hz tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Given a 50 Hz task, when SEP resolution is checked, then it is 20 msec.
Given a 10 Hz task or a 1 Hz task, when SEP resolution is checked, then it is 100 msec or 1 second respectively.

requirement_text: The system shall be available to users 24/7 with minimal downtime.
clarification_questions: What availability percentage and downtime are acceptable?

requirement_text: The flight NE shall be designed and constructed so that no part of any component shifts in setting, position, or adjustment.
requirement_text_raw: The flight NE  shall (3.2.3.1.3.2)  be designed and constructed so that no part of any component shifts in setting, position, or adjustment.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the flight NE built so that no part of any component shifts in setting, position or adjustment, so that it stays stable under flight conditions.
technical_task: Design and construct the flight NE so that no component part can change its setting, position or adjustment.
acceptance_criteria: Given the flight NE, when its components are inspected after exposure to its environment, then no part has shifted in setting.
Given the flight NE, when its components are inspected, then no part has shifted in position or adjustment.
rationale: Role assumed: hardware engineer. The environment for the inspection is not stated.

requirement_text: The throttle is to be implemented in such a way that in the entire operating temperature and operating voltage range each angle position between completely open and closed can be accessed.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want every angle position between completely open and closed reachable on the throttle across the entire temperature and voltage range, so that it can be controlled fully.
technical_task: Implement the throttle so each angle position between completely open and closed can be reached over the entire operating temperature and operating voltage range.
acceptance_criteria: Given any operating temperature and operating voltage within range, when an angle position between completely open and closed is requested, then the throttle can reach it.
Given the complete range, when the extremes are tested, then every angle position is still accessible.

requirement_text: Once a request to turn on or off a heating or cooling unit, the THEMAS system shall provide the necessary control signal for the unit.
user_story: As a building manager, I want the THEMAS system to provide the control signal to a heating or cooling unit when a request to turn it on or off is made, so that the unit responds.
technical_task: Send the required control signal to the heating or cooling unit when a request to turn it on or off arrives.
acceptance_criteria: Given a request to turn on a heating or cooling unit, when the request is made, then the THEMAS system provides the control signal for the unit.
Given a request to turn off a heating or cooling unit, when the request is made, then the THEMAS system provides the control signal for the unit.
rationale: Role assumed: building manager. The sentence is incomplete ("Once a request ...").

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to define transitions and animations for slides within a presentation.
user_story: As a presenter, I want to define transitions and animations for slides, so that my presentation looks the way I want.
technical_task: Provide settings for transitions and animations on each slide of a presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a slide, when the user defines a transition, then the transition is applied to the slide.
Given a slide, when the user defines an animation, then the animation is applied to the slide.

requirement_text: User data will be encrypted using industry-standard encryption algorithms, including payment information and personal data.
user_story: As a user, I want my data, including payment information and personal data, encrypted with industry-standard algorithms, so that it is protected.
technical_task: Encrypt user data, including payment information and personal data, using industry-standard encryption algorithms.
acceptance_criteria: Given payment information, when it is stored, then it is encrypted with an industry-standard algorithm.
Given personal data, when it is stored, then it is encrypted with an industry-standard algorithm.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The algorithms are not named.

requirement_text: The system shall support multicast protocols for sending multicast messages, requiring compatible routers, network cards, and operating systems.
user_story: As a network administrator, I want the system to support multicast protocols for sending multicast messages, with compatible routers, network cards and operating systems, so that multicast works.
technical_task: Support multicast protocols for sending multicast messages and require compatible routers, network cards and operating systems.
acceptance_criteria: Given compatible routers, network cards and operating systems, when a multicast message is sent, then it is delivered using a multicast protocol.
Given a component that is not compatible with multicast, when a multicast message is sent, then multicast delivery is not guaranteed.
rationale: Role assumed: network administrator. The second criterion is an interpretation of "requiring compatible" components.

requirement_text: The system shall implement user authentication and access controls based on user roles (e.g., standard user, administrator).
user_story: As an administrator, I want user authentication and role-based access controls, so that standard users and administrators get different permissions.
technical_task: Implement user authentication and access controls based on roles such as standard user and administrator.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with valid credentials, when the user logs in, then the user is authenticated and gets the permissions of the user's role.
Given a standard user, when the user tries an administrator action, then it is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. The roles in brackets are examples.

requirement_text: The list should now display all billables from the selected date range.
user_story: As a billing clerk, I want the list to show all billables from the selected date range, so that I can review them.
technical_task: Update the list to display all billables within the selected date range.
acceptance_criteria: Given a selected date range, when the list is displayed, then it shows all billables in that range.
Given a billable outside the selected date range, when the list is displayed, then it is not shown.

requirement_text: An employee will be able to successfully use the product within a few minutes.
rationale: "A few minutes" and "successfully use the product" are not defined.
clarification_questions: How many minutes count as "a few minutes"?
Which tasks must an employee be able to do successfully?

requirement_text: The platform shall have a community app showcasing data visualization examples.
user_story: As a researcher, I want a community app showing data visualization examples, so that I can see what is possible.
technical_task: Add a community app to the platform that showcases data visualization examples.
acceptance_criteria: Given the platform, when a user opens the community app, then data visualization examples are shown.
Given a data visualization example, when a user opens it, then it is displayed.

requirement_text: The system shall perform automatic plankton size/orientation detection in Plankton Portal images.
user_story: As a plankton researcher, I want automatic detection of plankton size and orientation in Plankton Portal images, so that I do not measure them by hand.
technical_task: Detect plankton size and orientation automatically in Plankton Portal images.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Plankton Portal image with plankton, when the system processes it, then plankton size is detected.
Given a Plankton Portal image with plankton, when the system processes it, then plankton orientation is detected.

requirement_text: The system shall rotate the picture by 90 degrees.
user_story: As a user, I want to rotate a picture by 90 degrees, so that it is shown the right way up.
technical_task: Add a function that rotates a picture by 90 degrees.
acceptance_criteria: Given a picture, when the user rotates it, then it is turned by 90 degrees.
Given a rotated picture, when it is displayed, then it shows the new orientation.

requirement_text: In the ingame screen, users can choose emote buttons by touching them, and upon selection, the chosen emote shall be displayed to the other user.
user_story: As a player, I want to choose an emote button on the in-game screen and have it shown to the other user, so that I can react during the game.
technical_task: Show emote buttons on the in-game screen and display the selected emote to the other user.
acceptance_criteria: Given the in-game screen, when the player touches an emote button, then the emote is chosen.
Given an emote has been chosen, when it is selected, then it is displayed to the other user.

requirement_text: All error messages must be meaningful and accompanied by explanatory text.
rationale: "Meaningful" is subjective and the explanatory text is not specified.
clarification_questions: What must the explanatory text contain?

requirement_text: User shall be able to manage settings such as alternate email address, phone number, preferred language, or password.
user_story: As a user, I want to manage settings such as my alternate email address, phone number, preferred language or password, so that my profile stays current.
technical_task: Provide a settings page for alternate email address, phone number, preferred language and password.
acceptance_criteria: Given the settings page, when the user changes the alternate email address, phone number or preferred language, then the change is saved.
Given the settings page, when the user changes the password, then the new password is saved.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Such as" means more settings may exist.

requirement_text: Name of the contractor shall be written smaller than the name of the Client.
user_story: As a client, I want the contractor's name written smaller than my name, so that the client is more prominent.
technical_task: Set the contractor's name in a smaller size than the client's name.
acceptance_criteria: Given a document with both names, when it is displayed, then the contractor's name is smaller than the client's name.
Given the two names, when their sizes are compared, then the client's name is the larger.

requirement_text: Special fit bolt will be used for mounting.
user_story: As a mechanical engineer, I want special fit bolts used for mounting, so that the mounting is accurate.
technical_task: Use special fit bolts for mounting.
acceptance_criteria: Given the mounting, when it is assembled, then special fit bolts are used.
Given the finished assembly, when it is inspected, then no standard bolts are used for the mounting.
rationale: Role assumed: mechanical engineer. The second criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: System shall adhere to specified quality attributes such as security and portability.
rationale: The quality attributes are only named as examples and have no criteria.
clarification_questions: Which quality attributes are "specified" and where?
What measurable criteria apply to security and portability?

requirement_text: User shall be able to block system access for a user by entering their card number.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to block system access for a user by entering their card number, so that lost or misused cards cannot be used.
technical_task: Allow a user to block system access for another user by entering that user's card number.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid card number, when the user enters it to block access, then system access is blocked for the card's user.
Given a blocked card number, when its user tries to access the system, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator; the requirement says user.

requirement_text: The system shall be able to activate the appropriate heating or cooling unit based on a predefined temperature differential between the current temperature and setting.
user_story: As a building manager, I want the right heating or cooling unit activated based on a predefined temperature differential, so that the temperature reaches the setting.
technical_task: Activate the heating or cooling unit that fits the difference between the current temperature and the setting, using a predefined temperature differential.
acceptance_criteria: Given the current temperature is below the setting by the predefined differential, when the system evaluates it, then the heating unit is activated.
Given the current temperature is above the setting by the predefined differential, when the system evaluates it, then the cooling unit is activated.
rationale: Role assumed: building manager. The differential value is not given.

requirement_text: User shall have an ALFRED device easily adaptable for users with visual or hearing impairments.
user_story: As a user with a visual or hearing impairment, I want an ALFRED device that is easy to adapt to my needs, so that I can use it.
technical_task: Provide adaptation options in the ALFRED device for users with visual or hearing impairments.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with a visual impairment, when the user adapts the ALFRED device, then the visual output is adjusted.
Given a user with a hearing impairment, when the user adapts the ALFRED device, then the audio output is adjusted.
rationale: Role assumed: user with an impairment. "Easily" is not measured and the adaptations are not listed.

requirement_text: The Mission Elapsed Time shall have a drift rate of at worst 50 PPM.
requirement_text_raw: The Mission Elapsed Time shall [SRS218] have a drift rate of at worst 50 PPM.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the Mission Elapsed Time drift rate to be at worst 50 PPM, so that elapsed time is accurate.
technical_task: Keep the drift rate of the Mission Elapsed Time within 50 PPM.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Mission Elapsed Time is running, when its drift rate is measured, then it is at worst 50 PPM.
Given a drift rate above 50 PPM, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: Redundancy Management shall reintegrate a failed FCP processor with the FCP virtual group when alignment is permitted and when the processor failure is not permanent.
requirement_text_raw: Redundancy Management shall [SRS110] reintegrate a failed FCP processor with the FCP virtual group when alignment is permitted and when the processor failure is not permanent.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Redundancy Management to reintegrate a failed FCP processor with the FCP virtual group when alignment is permitted and the failure is not permanent, so that capacity is restored.
technical_task: Reintegrate a failed FCP processor into the FCP virtual group when alignment is permitted and the processor failure is not permanent.
acceptance_criteria: Given a failed FCP processor with a non-permanent failure and alignment is permitted, when Redundancy Management handles it, then the processor is reintegrated with the FCP virtual group.
Given a permanent failure or alignment is not permitted, when Redundancy Management handles the processor, then it is not reintegrated.

requirement_text: If a light system damping of the DTR sensor is observed, but no relevant influence on the system functionality is present (all object data etc. are still determined and transmitted) the condition DTR_SysDamp equal ``1''/INC_DAMP is sent and a connected near range sensor system can sensitise the damping detection with this information if necessary.
user_story: As a driver assistance engineer, I want DTR_SysDamp equal 1 / INC_DAMP sent when the DTR sensor shows light system damping without relevant influence on functionality, so that a near range sensor can use it.
technical_task: When light system damping of the DTR sensor is observed and all object data are still determined and transmitted, send DTR_SysDamp equal 1 / INC_DAMP so a connected near range sensor system can sensitise its damping detection if necessary.
acceptance_criteria: Given light system damping of the DTR sensor with no relevant influence on system functionality, when it is observed, then DTR_SysDamp equal 1 / INC_DAMP is sent.
Given DTR_SysDamp equal 1 / INC_DAMP is sent, when a near range sensor system is connected, then it can sensitise its damping detection with this information.

requirement_text: The administrator shall have the capability to modify the expected range of sensed data against which the data will be validated.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to modify the expected range of sensed data used for validation, so that validation matches the sensor.
technical_task: Provide a setting that lets the administrator change the expected range against which sensed data is validated.
acceptance_criteria: Given the validation settings, when the administrator changes the expected range, then the new range is saved.
Given sensed data, when it is validated, then it is checked against the current expected range.

requirement_text: The system shall be designed for intuitive use by first-time users.
clarification_questions: How is "intuitive use by first-time users" measured?
What tasks must a first-time user complete without help?

requirement_text: The FCP shall configure ICP simplex virtual groups for each channel in the FCP virtual group.
requirement_text_raw: The FCP shall [SRS296] configure ICP simplex virtual groups for each channel in the FCP virtual group.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FCP to configure ICP simplex virtual groups for each channel in the FCP virtual group, so that each channel has its virtual group.
technical_task: Configure one ICP simplex virtual group on the FCP for every channel in the FCP virtual group.
acceptance_criteria: Given a channel in the FCP virtual group, when the FCP configures the ICPs, then an ICP simplex virtual group is configured for it.
Given several channels in the FCP virtual group, when the FCP configures the ICPs, then each channel has its own ICP simplex virtual group.

requirement_text: The system shall have a user-friendly interface that is intuitive and easy to navigate for users with varying technical skills.
clarification_questions: What does "user-friendly" and "easy to navigate" mean in measurable terms?
Which technical skill levels must be covered?

requirement_text: Broadcast primitives shall not be available on ICPs.
requirement_text_raw: Broadcast primitives shall (3.3.6.10) not be available on ICPs.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want broadcast primitives not to be available on ICPs, so that ICPs cannot broadcast.
technical_task: Disable broadcast primitives on ICPs.
acceptance_criteria: Given an ICP, when a broadcast primitive is used on it, then it is not available.
Given an ICP, when its available primitives are listed, then broadcast primitives are not included.

requirement_text: The Project Team must demonstrate mockups of UI changes to project stakeholders early in the development process.
rationale: "Early in the development process" is not defined.
clarification_questions: How early in the development process must mockups be shown?
Which UI changes and which stakeholders are meant?

requirement_text: User shall/will be able to integrate with Netbeans IDE 7.2.1 for Java development and MySQL Query Browser for database management.
user_story: As a developer, I want the application to integrate with Netbeans IDE 7.2.1 for Java development and MySQL Query Browser for database management, so that I can use my tools.
technical_task: Support integration with Netbeans IDE 7.2.1 for Java development and with MySQL Query Browser for database management.
acceptance_criteria: Given Netbeans IDE 7.2.1, when a developer uses it for Java development, then the application integrates with it.
Given MySQL Query Browser, when a developer uses it for database management, then the application integrates with it.
